description: Ba₄NaCuO₄(CO₃)₂ crystallizes in the tetragonal I̅42m space group. Na is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six O atoms. There are four shorter (2.31 Å) and two longer (2.34 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Ba is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten O atoms. There are a spread of Ba-O bond distances ranging from 2.76-3.36 Å. Cu is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Cu-O bond lengths are 1.87 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.30 Å) and one longer (1.31 Å) C-O bond length. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to four equivalent Ba and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, four equivalent Ba, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to one Na, four equivalent Ba, and one Cu atom to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing OBa₄NaCu octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-3°.
